Welcome To CKB Commerce College, Jorhat
The College was founded in 1965 under the leadership of Late Madhab Chandra Chakraborty as the Founder Principal along with a few teachers namely Late Dwijendra Nath Sarmah, Sri Anil Chandra Sarmah and Sri Khagendra Nath Sarmah Baruah. Initially the college started with only 130 students. The college was brought under the Deficit Grants-in-Aid system in 1974 and the college got recognized by the University Grants Commission in the same year.
Read More

Principal Desk’s
Established in 1965, Chandra Kamal Bezbaruah Commerce College, one of the premier institutions imparting Commerce Education in the N.E. Region, is situated in the heart of Jorhat Town. The college has been assessed and accredited with ‘B++’ grade by National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) in the year 2022.
